namePrefix.description: Optional convenience (not a Terraform variable): <namePrefix>- in front of every folder's display name. A DNS label. Empty changes nothing.

labels.description: Kubernetes labels on every object; an unprefixed key is also checked as a Google Cloud label.

tags.description: Cloud labels on every resource (Google Cloud labels: lower-case letters, digits, _ and -).

deletion_policy.description: Not a module variable. PREVENT is refused (no Config Connector equivalent).

resource_ids.description: Not a Terraform variable: existing folders to adopt, {hfl.dev/id of the Folder object (folder:<name>): folder number or folders/<number>}.

all_folder_admins.description: List of IAM-style members that will get the extended permissions across all the folders.

deletion_protection.description: Prevent Terraform from destroying or recreating the folder. Accepted and ignored: Terraform-only; Folder has no such field.

folder_admin_roles.description: List of roles that will be applied to a folder if roles are not explictly specified in per_folder_admins

parent.description: The resource name of the parent Folder or Organization. Must be of the form folders/folder_id or organizations/org_id

per_folder_admins.description: IAM-style roles per members per folder who will get extended permissions. If roles are not provided for a folder/member combination, the list provided as `folder_admin_roles` will be applied as default.

prefix.description: Optional prefix to enforce uniqueness of folder names.

set_roles.description: Enable setting roles via the folder admin variables.
